## Checks

- [ ] `bun run check` passes
- [ ] A test guards the change, and fails without it
- [ ] Docs describe the code after this change: `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` for modules, flows
  and invariants; an ADR in `docs/decisions/` for a new or reversed decision;
  `docs/development.md` or a package README for commands and workflows
